studentHomework.allHints: You have seen all the hints
studentHomework.problem: A 1500 kg car collides with a 200 kg motorbike. Which one exerts a greater force on the other at the moment of impact? And why?
studentHomework.title: Homework

hints.one: Start by identifying the two objects in the interaction.
hints.two: Think about what Newton third law says about every force pair.
hints.three: Mass changes acceleration, not the size of the force pair.
hints.title: Work through the hints
hints.description: Reveal one step at a time, then return to your answer.

studentHomework.nextHint: Need a hint? Ask for the next step
studentHomework.answerPlaceholder: Write your answer in your own words. Rafiqi will not solve it for you; it walks with you.

correct.text: Both exert the same force on each other. The motorbike moves more because of its smaller mass, not because the force is greater.
correct.title: Excellent! You got there yourself.
